evals.prompt: 我时间线上现在有哪些标签？分别用在多少条事件上？
evals.expected_output: Runs list.mjs (or GET /api/tags) and reports 个人(3), 临时(2), 工作(3) with counts; makes no mutations.

evals.prompt: 把 #工作 这个标签改名为 #个人
evals.expected_output: Discovers 个人 already exists → presents rename plan with merge warning + affected events (3) and asks for approval; does NOT execute the rename (server state unchanged).

evals.prompt: 昨天有条事件带了 #个人 标签，把那条的标签去掉就行
evals.expected_output: Recognizes single-event scope: identifies yesterday's event and edits its content via the event API; never calls global tag rename/remove endpoints.

evals.prompt: #临时 这个标签彻底没用了，帮我全局清掉
evals.expected_output: Presents removal plan (2 affected events) with samples and asks for approval; does NOT execute (临时 still on server).
